reviews.text: I can not say enough good things about this company! I have been looking for a groomer for my 80 lb shepherd mix for months. We have been turned away by a number of places, or quoted an insane amount of money because he’s nervous, anxious and big/strong. He hates getting his nails trimmed (almost broke my jaw at one point) and hates the bath just as much. I had countless emails with Vlada and the team and they all reassured me that they could get the job done AND help my boy feel more comfortable when getting groomed in the future. Boy did they deliver. We drove 35 min each way to them, and it was worth every cent. Not only does he look and smell amazing, his nails are a normal length now!! We will be lifelong customers now! Thank you Noah and team, you guys rocked it and Kevin says “THANK YOU!” 🐾🐶

Haley is amazing! My 6 month Pomeranian is a bundle of anxiety and struggles with cuts and brushes, it’s a working progress. Hayley took her time and love and treated him amazingly! He looks so fresh and confident! Thank you Haley!

I’ve brought my kitty Stella here twice now and am very satisfied. The owner Vlada is so sweet and friendly . My kitty has high anxiety and they have their own special grooming room for cats so it really helps. I am very comfortable with leaving her with them as I trust that she’s in great hands!

Vlada was great with my cats! i was nervous since it was their first ever groom, but Vlada was able to get my kitties freshened up and super clean. Definitely would come back here again. The groomers are very knowledgeable and skilled.

The care, attention to detail, and relationship they have for my doodle is amazing. I know when taking him to them he will be cared for and comes out looking amazing. 5/5, Jessica will be the best groomer you’ll ever choose!

I continue to come here for the service as stated below from previous months!! I highly recommend.

I recently brought a four year old Pomeranian home. I needed to find a groomer. I found Paws with Claws online with raving reviews. I take reviews serious and made the right choice. We were greeted and my dog was immediately comfortable in the environment. Haley knew what she was talking about with his haircut and made me feel at ease. Wow, the result was AWESOME and l received many compliments from family! This is our new place and we look forward to coming back. Thanks again Haley you did great!! And to the shop as a whole for the environment. I attached the photos of him before and after.

I visited with my dog as a walk-in and asked for nail clip.   I was well received and checked her in with the help of a very friendly staff.  I expressed that I also was interested in the overnight stays.   Vlada asked me if I would like to leave my pet for a few hours to become familiar and comfortable with the area.   I did so and returned later that day.   Everything went very well.   Her nails were clipped and the person fold me how she behaved and I saw my dog was very calm and happy.   I will continue coming back as I greatly appreciate the care and attention to my little one and to me.

My dog Panda is a big chicken but Aniah (probably spelled wrong) was super sweet and patient with him. They used a special shampoo from the vet that had to stay on for 10 minutes once lathered and he had a lot of dead skin that was removed. This is the second time we’ve been here and I think he’s finally getting used to the pampering. 😁💕

We have been taking our rough collie, Coda, here for almost two years now, and this place never fails to impress me. After taking him to another place in Ahwatukee that groomed him in 2 hours (which is ridiculously fast and he was in tons of pain afterwards), he refused to walk into the other place again and I knew I needed to find a new groomer.

Finding Paws with Claws was such a win! They do SUCH an amazing and thorough job and they take as much time as it needs—we usually drop him off around 9 AM and pick him up at 7 PM. They never rush and always make sure he is happy and comfortable. They do exactly what we ask, and he always looks and smells great after…I can’t recommend this place enough!

Paws with Claws took such great care of my boy! My dog is a 14 year old, grumpy man. He is particular in a lot of ways. We prefaced this with the groomer on his first drop off. They said he did fine and I truly think this is the best he’s ever looked post grooming! We showed some pictures for reference and Haley nailed it.
